entries.boundary: Runtime-neutral turn stream consuming the classic strategy stream
entries.reason: Unknown strategy exceptions must emit the existing generic typed error after pending events and then propagate unchanged. Narrowing to a fixed exception list would omit the required terminal error for other strategy failures; this is not successful recovery.
entries.diagnostic_path: TurnErrorEvent serializes to the existing constant-safe SSE error, followed by a bare re-raise to the caller. This handler does not log or serialize exception content.
